instagram.caption:
What the box is actually for.
The Outdoor Storage Zone in the Patio or Deck. Get the cushions under a lid within a minute of the first drop of rain.

What done looks like:
1. The lid closes flat without anyone pressing down
2. Cushions in one layer on top
3. Two labelled totes beneath them
4. The floor of the box visible the moment the cushions come out

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success outdoor storage zone.
